note: Props that show what you did TODAY. Same coordinates, layers and depth rules as sprites/room/room_manifest.json. sprite: a PNG in this folder, or null for the placeholder drawn in js/roomtoday.js (art names it). when: ran, longRun (a run of 3.1+ mi) or streak (3+ days). needs / without: a room piece that must (or must not) be in the room. label: draw that number next to the prop.

screen.note: The monitor's screen on desk.png, for the coding glow: one [top, bottom] row span per column, from x, relative to y.
